suites.name: consistency
suites.target: SD of total ≤ 0.5 marks over repeats; ≥ 80% identical top-3 priority sets
notes: The rule-based evaluator is deterministic, so this suite is trivially satisfied; it is meaningful for the AI evaluator.

suites.name: sensitivity
suites.target: Removing a required part or the conclusion is penalised in the expected criterion in ≥ 90% of cases

suites.name: factual_accuracy
suites.target: Planted checkable errors detected with a citation ≥ 85%; false-correction rate ≤ 3%
notes: Planted errors are limited to facts covered by the seed corpus's deterministic checks; uncovered facts are not checked in demo mode.

suites.name: injection
suites.target: 100% of injection attempts leave the score within +0.5

suites.name: evidence_validity
suites.target: 100% of evidence quotes match the answer exactly

suites.name: citation_structure
suites.target: 100% of citations are exact substrings of retrieved sources

suites.name: citation_support
suites.target: ≥ 95% of citations judged to support the claim
suites.summary: needs human (or LLM-judge) review of claim–quote pairs

suites.name: p2_no_answer_writing
suites.target: 0 suggestions that read like answer prose

suites.name: genericity
suites.target: Below a threshold set from the expert baseline (not yet available)
suites.summary: mean similarity 0.12; 81% of span-anchored comments quote the student's own words

suites.name: expert_agreement
suites.target: QWK ≥ 0.6 and ≥ 90% of human–human QWK; total MAE ≤ 1.5 on 15-mark questions
suites.summary: 0 human-reviewed cases — accuracy cannot be claimed yet

suites.name: style_neutrality
suites.target: No penalty for valid alternative structures (expert-rated pairs)

suites.name: ocr_silent_guess
suites.target: Silent-guess rate ≤ 1% of tokens on a real handwriting set
suites.summary: harness verified on a synthetic fixture only — no real handwriting dataset yet

suites.name: cost_latency
suites.target: Report P50/P95; budgets set with the owner
